basic_info.description: Welcome to 175 Bluxome #213. Live and Work at this spacious 2 level loft condo. This is a 2 beds and 2 baths separate in each level. Newly oak hardwood floor, new interior paint and move in ready.  1 car garage assigned. HOA $795 per month including water garbage, common area, master insurance.  Walking distance to Trader Joes, Caltrain, Pinterest, Chase Center, Adobe, Safeway and Easy access to highway 280/101/8. Shown by Appointment only, vacant.
